# hiok_bastion (Resource)

A bastion that joins a virtual network so browsers can reach its VMs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Address on that network in CIDR form, e.g. 10.0.0.9/24.
- `name` (String)
- `vnet_name` (String) Virtual network to serve.

### Optional

- `gateway` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `sku` (String)
- `vlan_tag` (Number) VLAN tag on the network's bridge.
- `vnet_id` (String) Virtual network to attach to, by id.

### Read-Only

- `attached` (Boolean) True once the daemon holds an interface on the network.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `portal_url` (String) Where browser sessions are opened.
- `status` (String)
